purpose: Only proof, measurement correspondence and test fixture choices; no player-facing value changed.
figure_height_measurement: inclusive vertical bounding-box span of the assembled rest silhouette, fixed for that view
contact_for_touching_paint: mean of shared grid-edge midpoints; both adjacent pieces pose each contact
contact_for_separated_paint: mean of all exact nearest painted pixel-centre pairs; no distance allowance
garment_zone_correspondence: existing humanoid ownership segments, with semantic aliases listed in calibration.json
